defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Enumerates all assignments with `itertools.product`, giving exponential 3^n work and timing out at the allowed bounds.
Its implemented search/checking logic does not correctly solve the resulting exact equality/colouring condition, producing a wrong answer.

recommended_edit: Keep the mathematical task unchanged but define the collaborative load through an equivalent opaque case-based audit rule or named lookup function, instead of displaying the expanded quartic polynomial; this is the only shared statement-level affordance to target, although the underlying 3-colouring structure remains intrinsic.
regression_risk: A sufficiently strong solver can still evaluate the equivalent lookup and recover the same 3-colouring reduction; hiding the formula may also make the already-defeated exhaustive solver less likely to reproduce its current implementation error.
